title: Live Dashboard
content: Build live updating dashboard. Real-time data: WebSocket or polling for updates. Animation: smooth transitions on data changes. Current status: show live values. Recent activity: stream of recent events. Pulse indicators: show active/live state. Connection status: indicate if connected. Auto-refresh: configurable refresh interval. Pause: ability to pause updates.

variants.simple: Create real-time dashboard with auto-updating metrics.
variants.detailed: Build live updating dashboard. Real-time data: WebSocket or polling for updates. Animation: smooth transitions on data changes. Current status: show live values. Recent activity: stream of recent events. Pulse indicators: show active/live state. Connection status: indicate if connected. Auto-refresh: configurable refresh interval. Pause: ability to pause updates.
variants.advanced: Build real-time dashboard with live updating data. Data connection: WebSocket for true real-time, or polling (5-30 second intervals). Connection status: indicator showing connected/disconnected/reconnecting, auto-reconnect with exponential backoff. Live metrics: current value updating in real-time, smooth number transitions (animate counting), pulse or glow effect on updates. Activity stream: feed of recent events/transactions, new items animate in at top, auto-scroll or "N new items" button, click to expand details. Current users: live count of active users, geographic distribution updating, active pages being viewed. Live chart: line chart that extends in real-time, rolling window (last 5 minutes), smooth animation for new data points. Threshold alerts: visual alert when metric exceeds threshold, color change, optional sound. Server status: health indicators for systems, green/yellow/red status, latency/response time. Pause/resume: button to pause updates, resume button shows backlog count. Refresh indicator: spinning icon or progress bar during data fetch, last updated timestamp. Buffer handling: handle data bursts, batch updates to prevent flickering. Reconnection: graceful handling of connection loss, show reconnecting status, fetch missed data on reconnect. Performance: efficient DOM updates, virtualize long lists, debounce rapid updates. Mobile: battery-conscious polling frequency, reduce update frequency in background. Keyboard shortcut: press to pause/resume. Sound: optional notification sounds for alerts. Full screen mode: distraction-free large display mode for monitoring.
